sources.title: Mauritius Passport and Immigration Office: Travel Requirements
sources.officialityEvidence: This is the official Passport and Immigration Office entry-document and admissibility guidance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Entrants must produce a passport issued by a government of which they are a national or citizen.

unresolved.reason: Not established: no opened official source expressly gives Mauritian citizens a visitor-entry classification. The destination/passport code match is not treated as citizenship evidence.
